name: grimmsnarl_ml_v3
deck_note: Unchanged from v2: the byte-identical dominant top-50 Grimmsnarl list.
policy: The frozen v2.1 919-tree candidate ranker remains pinned to pilot 16494330 and retains its effective-damage, wall, Boss, damage-counter and turn-history semantics. v3 adds a 15-class, 143-tree-per-class LightGBM next-action prior trained on 62,594 chronological training decisions from leaderboard ranks 4/5/9/11/13. The prior sees candidate-invariant public state, the legal action-family menu and frozen v2 score summaries. Runtime combines per-decision z-normalised v2 scores with alpha 0.10 times the prior raw class logit. v2 still chooses the concrete card or target. Multi-pick and unmeasured contexts retain the v7 fallback.
selection: Alpha maximised elite validation strict Top-1 subject to no more than 0.60 point validation loss against the pinned v2 teacher. Alpha 0.10 improved elite validation by 0.84 points while the pinned-teacher validation loss was 0.51 points. The chronological test block was scored after selection.
validation_scope: On 9,792 chronological elite test decisions, pinned v2 agreement improves from 75.84% to 76.37% (+0.53pt); all five elite pilots improve individually. On the pinned teacher's 1,480 test decisions, agreement changes from 91.96% to 91.82% (-0.14pt). Shipped-runtime teacher-forced evaluation: rank-4 all-context 67.11% to 67.72% (+0.61pt), rank-4 MAIN 60.01% to 61.12% (+1.11pt), pinned all-context 91.34% to 91.20% (-0.14pt). Paired local self-play versus v2: 35-25 over 60 games, with 0 errors, 0 illegal actions and 0 fallbacks. Runtime replay latency averaged about 34 ms with p95 about 66 ms. The multiclass JSON export matches native LightGBM raw logits exactly on deterministic probes (max absolute error 0). Ladder rating is not measured.
description: v3 conservatively transfers the shared next-action ordering of five leaderboard-top Grimmsnarl pilots into the proven v2.1 candidate policy. It improves held-out elite agreement and paired self-play while keeping pinned-pilot drift to 0.14 points on test.
